name: Instruments
overview: Scripture emphasizes the use of instruments and music as vital expressions of worship within the church, encouraging believers to praise God both corporately and personally. The Psalms call for praising God with a variety of instruments in His sanctuary, while the New Testament instructs believers to sing psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs with melody and grace in their hearts to the Lord. This demonstrates that musical instruments and singing are integral to teaching, admonishing, and uplifting one another in the body of Christ.
